skywain-trip-planner-skill-root.description: End-to-end international trip planning: turns "I want to go to X for N days" into a verified, bookable plan — route skeleton across cities, flight price scans (international + domestic legs), train-vs-fly decisions, hour-by-hour daily timelines with opening hours, dwell times, holiday collisions and tappable turn-by-turn map links (小时级行程+地图导航+离线KML), hotel shortlists by neighborhood, budget rollup, and a booking checklist with deep links.
